NATIONAL WATER SUPPLY AND DRAINAGE BOARD ACT, No. 02 OF 1974
Order under Section 92

BY virtue of the powers vested in me, under Section 92 of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act, No.02 of1974, I, Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, do hereby approve the acquisition of immovableproperty, shown in the following Schedule as it is required by the National Water Supply and Drainage Board for constructionof Panangala Water Tank and official quarters under the Bandarawela Diyathalawa Integrated Water Supply Project.
RAUFF HAKEEM,Minister of City Planning and
Water Supply.Ministry of City Planning and Water Supply,No. 35,New Parliament Road,Pelawatta, Battaramulla,06th June, 2018.5/2/1/1379
SCHEDULE

The allotment of land called Icelayb Waththa Kurukude portion field No. 04, situated in the village of KurukudegamaPanangala in the Grama Niladhari Division of Kurukudegama in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Haliela in BadullaDistrict containing in extent of about 01 Acre and bounded as follows :—

North by:Balance portion of this land ;East by:Estate road from Icelayb Waththa to Atampitiya road ;South by:Estate road from Icelayb Waththa to Atampitiya road and land belongs to ForestConservation Department ;West by:Balance portion of the land.
Name and address of the claimant :
Chief Executive Officer,Malwaththa Weli Plantation Company,Icelayb Waththa,Bandarawela.07-504
